criteria.label: Innovation
criteria.description: Original idea, creative problem-solving and innovation on real-world needs.

criteria.label: Technical Complexity
criteria.description: Depth and sophistication of the implementation; robustness and scalability.

criteria.label: Usability
criteria.description: Intuitive, accessible and inclusive, with the end user considered.

criteria.label: Adherence to Theme
criteria.description: Alignment with the chosen theme or challenge and creativity in interpreting it.

judging.judge_profile_summary: Judges are not named on the event page.
judging.notes: The Devpost page names five themed tracks (Greenprint, Lifeline, Overdrive, Portal, Brainrot) without describing them. The event duration is not stated.

curator_notes: All 30 prize winners are analyzed records. The Grand Award is the single overall prize; track and sponsor winners are track-winner, unranked where several share a prize. Neither team size nor duration is stated on Devpost. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
